text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated error rates detected for hosted-api (us-west1) across model endpoints. 5xx spike ~4.8% (5m), 429s ~12% (5m). Automated throttles engaged. Paging on-call. thread_ts=1937654321

Maya (oncall): got it, on it. pulling logs and quota metrics now.

Paul: seeing a big bump in quota-service 500s starting ~1937652000, correlated with a config deploy. sample logs: `quota-service error: failed to apply policy: write timeout -> 500`

Jon: on standby, can take after initial triage.

Maya (oncall): quick summary from metrics:
- gateway 5xx ~4.8% (baseline 0.2%)
- 429 spike focused on routing layer and a global quota enforcement shard
- a lot of retries causing backend saturation -> cascade (502/504)

Alex: any user-visible outages reported?

cs-bot: CS flagged a handful of high-volume customers experiencing timeouts; support tickets created for customer IDs: C-9931, C-8822.

Maya (oncall): I'm seeing a config rollout at 1937651000 that added `global_quota_enforce: true` to multiple services. suspect that. grabbing the deploy id.

Paul: confirmed deploy id `deploy-rl-2026-03-15-14:36` touched `rate-limit-config` and promoted a strict bucket across all regions. The previous config had per-customer exceptions that were lost in the new promotion.

Sasha: if per-customer exceptions were removed, that would explain 429s for heavy customers and the retry storm. we need to revert or disable global enforcement.

Maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) rollback the config promotion 2) open temporary bypass for premium customers 3) throttle retries at gateway 4) monitor error rates. executing rollback now.

Maya (oncall): rollback command:```bash
infractl config rollback --service rate-limit --to-revision 4122 --reason "emergency: global quota misapply"
```

Alex: also flip `enforce_global_quota=false` via remote flag so we don't need a full deploy if rollback stalls.

Maya (oncall): good call. running flag toggle:```bash
featurectl set rate_limit.enforce_global_quota false --scope global --origin emergency
```

incident-bot: ACTION: rollback started by Maya (oncall) at 1937652900, notify: #status-page, top-customer-ops.

Jon: I'll take the handoff from here in ~15. Maya, if rollback finishes OK, drop a summary and I’ll coordinate postmortem and CS comms.

Maya (oncall): rollback completed at 1937653125. logs show: `apply config revision 4122 succeeded`. flipping monitoring to watch errors.

Paul: watching metrics — 5xx back down to 0.6% within 3 minutes, 429s to 1.8% and trending down. :thumbsup:

Maya (oncall): opening temporary exception rule for premium customers until we patch the config generation:```json
{
  "rule": "allow",
  "scope": "customer",
  "customer_ids": ["C-9931","C-8822","C-7704"],
  "expires_at": "2026-03-15T16:00:00Z"
}
```

Sasha: I'll push a small guard in the config CI to prevent global enforcement without explicit approval. PR coming.

Emily: CS notified customers and posted interim status on status.redwood.ai. advising retries with exponential backoff for now.

Jon: taking over incident lead. next steps for post-incident:
- confirm root cause (config promotion removed per-customer exceptions)
- roll forward a patched config with tests
- write postmortem and mitigation steps (CI guard + feature flag change)
- customer remediation plan (credits + notes)

Paul: bookmarking relevant logs and alerts for postmortem. capturing correlation id samples.

Maya (oncall): handoff to Jon at 1937653400. I'm available if something flares. going offline for short break.

Jon: thanks Maya. I'm going to coordinate with infra and deploy the patched config. ETA 30m.

incident-bot: NOTE: automated reroutes enabled during mitigation window; some requests were proxied to lower-cost model variants as fallback — logs available under `fallback-routing` stream.

Jon: patch PR created: `pr/rl-fix-global-exception` which restores per-customer exception merge logic and adds CI guard. linking diff: https://git.internal/redwood/rl-config/pull/432

Sasha: reviewing PR, will expedite review and request CI exemption for emergency deploy.

Jon: applying hotfix deploy now: `deploy-rl-hotfix-1937654200`

Paul: metrics after hotfix: 5xx ~0.15%, 429s ~0.2%. looks stable for past 10m.

cs-bot: CS update: customers C-9931 and C-8822 have been proactively updated; both acknowledged and requested final postmortem.

Jon: wrap-up notes: root cause = misapplied rate-limit promotion that removed per-customer whitelists -> global quota enforcement -> high 429s and retry cascade -> backend saturation -> 5xx gateway errors. Mitigations executed: immediate rollback, feature flag disable, temporary customer exceptions, hotfix + CI guard, CS outreach.

Jon: assigning postmortem owner Sasha. ETA draft in 48h.

Sasha: ack, will own postmortem and remediation follow-ups.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: Incident marked resolved at 1937654650. Closing alert. Please file follow-ups for long-term fixes and customer credits.

Maya (oncall): thanks all — nice quick reaction. :sparkles:

Alex: great collaboration. recommend a runbook update to include explicit verification step for per-customer exceptions before promoting global rules.

Jon: adding that to the postmortem. closing thread.
